title: AXD Reconnect
description: Automatically reconnect to servers when disconnected. Includes a customizable timer and a simple toggle to easily enable or disable the feature.
body:
![AXD Reconnect](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/24c2faf4d598cbcd34c528a4645b7101f8bd5023.jpeg)



![AXD Reconnect Banner ](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/617c4b70e5b7fd7c0bb47c6c688dabd498ef5f52.png)

Have you ever been AFK or disconnected randomly from a server, only to realize you lost your spot or missed out on something important? **AXD Reconnect** is a simple, lightweight client-side mod that automatically reconnects you to the server after you get disconnected!


![Features](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/facff495a77a332cc02285c14b86ee8f5da6a8b3.png)

* **Automatic Reconnection:** Seamlessly and automatically reconnects you to servers when the connection drops.
* **Initial Connection Failure Support:** The mod catches early connection failures and will automatically retry connecting even if the first attempt fails!
* **Fully Customizable Timer:** Set exactly how many seconds the mod should wait before attempting to reconnect.
* **Master Toggle:** A simple "Auto Reconnect" ON/OFF switch in the settings to quickly enable or disable the mod's features globally.


![Configuration](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9882991459e3cb32d3bbdecceacf8a221003f0b7.png)

AXD Reconnect is fully configurable in-game! 
Make sure you have **ModMenu** and **Cloth Config API** installed.

Go to your Mods menu, find **AXD Reconnect**, and click the settings button. You will easily be able to configure:
- **Auto Reconnect:** Turn the main feature ON or OFF.
- **Delay:** Enter the delay (in seconds) before the mod tries to reconnect you.


![installation](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/457935ad5351fe51161750a4f6cc09416daf0249.png)

1. Ensure you have the [Fabric API] installed.
2. Drop the **AXD Reconnect** `.jar` into your `mods` folder.
3. (Highly Recommended) Add [ModMenu] and [Cloth Config API] to access the settings menu easily.

Enjoy AFKing and never worry about random disconnects breaking your session again!
